description: This file defines a REST API class for exporting and importing assets in the Superset application, including endpoints for exporting assets as ZIP files and importing assets from ZIP or JSON files, with handling for various security and data validation aspects.

classes.name: ImportExportRestApi
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for exporting all assets as ZIP and importing assets from ZIP or JSON files, with security, logging, and metrics integration.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Handles GET requests to export all assets as a ZIP file containing YAML files.

methods.name: import_
methods.description: Handles POST requests to import assets from uploaded ZIP or JSON files, with optional password and SSH key handling.
